subject: reasoning
question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6547ebc34b51722fd3954e4a2cffc2d277850535b3c491197f25a94e2198845b.png] 

Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '2'?
solution:
Taking in consideration position (2) and (3) of the dice :

No common face is there.

So, the respective faces of two dices will be opposite to each other.

Opposite pairs are :

1 - 5

2 - 6

3 - 4

**So, the number on the opposite face of the face with number 2 is 6.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"6"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

** Standard dice :**

When sum of opposite faces of a dice is 7, it is known as standard dice.
